decision: Plan 011 is executed by the five-pack integration PR (#22): its embedded pack, helpers and checksum manifests stay as the historical record of the 2026-10-02 rehearsal and are not regenerated; its maintenance notes are rewritten to work on template/stacks/foldkit directly (no step-2.sh replay); row 011 is DONE only once every #20 finding has a disposition and the final tree passes its light, heavy and hosted gates
rationale: The implementation now lands in the same PR, so a replay of the plan is moot; regenerating manifests for it would only keep dead helpers in sync. Codex disagreed with marking it DONE on execution alone and required an acceptance procedure; adopted. Supersedes the 2026-10-04 byte-identical decision.
alternatives_considered: Regenerate pack.sha256/helpers.sha256 and re-anchor the plan for a replay nobody will run

decision: Foldkit guard rules (framework boundary, module mocks, DevTools relay, MCP launcher, src file types) move from line greps to scripts/check-rules.mjs, a Node-stdlib checker on a restricted tokenizer that rejects every unsupported use of the governed bindings (vite.config.ts: one exact foldkit import and one call with { devToolsMcpPort: false } or no argument; no other vite config or --config)
rationale: Seven grep bypasses reproduced (#20 items 6, 7, 22, 23); Codex showed a decoy-plus-alias bypass of a call-count rule, so the checker restricts syntax instead of matching patterns
alternatives_considered: oxlint no-restricted-imports (misses import()/require()); evaluating the Vite config at runtime with a module hook

decision: Foldkit age rule: wait a day by default; the only fast path is exact name@version minimumReleaseAgeExclude entries for the currently pinned train releases, removed once they mature; never minimum_release_age=0, bare names or scopes. check-pins.mjs enforces the whole pnpm-workspace.yaml policy and the guard and after-bootstrap run pnpm with policy env overrides cleared
rationale: #20 items 10, 11, 13 and the catalog-ops lesson that pnpm_config_* env vars beat pnpm-workspace.yaml; Codex required exemptions to match actual pinned versions

decision: Foldkit lockfile changes land only through a PR whose reviewer reads the complete pnpm-lock.yaml diff (both YAML documents: resolutions, integrity, importers, snapshots), with a package/version summary as a supplement; regeneration happens in a scratch copy
rationale: #20 item 25; Codex disagreed with a packages-keys-only comparison because it misses integrity and dependency changes

decision: Vendored Foldkit keeps the clone .git as a git boundary and is pinned by .foldkit-ref (version + commit) that vendor-foldkit.sh verifies and check-pins ties to the foldkit pin
rationale: #20 item 12 (mutable tag) and a verified simple-git-hooks rewrite of the project hooks when .git was stripped

decision: Ship the five-pack integration as 0.3.0 (MINOR); PR #19 (v0.2.0, Rust alone) is superseded by PR #22
rationale: New opt-in packs change what new projects get, as the 0.1.0 Python precedent; Codex agreed
